articles.title: Trump’s ‘Great Healthcare Plan’ Aims to Lower Drug Prices and Insurance Premiums
articles.mainIdea: Trump’s ‘Great Healthcare Plan’ Aims to Lower Drug Prices and Insurance Premiums
articles.summary: Bloomberg: Trump’s ‘Great Healthcare Plan’ Aims to Lower Drug Prices and Insurance Premiums. “I’m calling on Congress to pass this framework into law without delay — have to do it right now so that we can get immediate relief to the American people,” Trump said in a video message, calling his proposal “The Great Healthcare Plan.” The outline called for “codifying” the voluntary deals Trump has made with drugmakers to lower some prices and making more medicines available over the counter. Related tickers mentioned: CNC, CVS, ELV, MOH, OSCR, UNH.

articles.title: The Cigna Group Renews Support for Achilles International's Freedom Team, Empowering Wounded Veterans and Adaptive Athletes
articles.mainIdea: The Cigna Group Renews Support for Achilles International's Freedom Team, Empowering Wounded Veterans and Adaptive Athletes
articles.summary: PR Newswire: The Cigna Group Renews Support for Achilles International's Freedom Team, Empowering Wounded Veterans and Adaptive Athletes. The Cigna Group (NYSE: CI), a global health company, committed nearly $1 million over the next three years to help wounded veterans and athletes with disabilities participate in premier endurance races across the country through a renewed, multiyear sponsorship of the Achilles Freedom Team. This expanded commitment builds on The Cigna Group's longstanding collaboration with Achilles International and reinforces the company's mission to improve health, vitality, and community connection.
